title: V4 BU Autopilot Artifact Reference
description: Reference from one Intelligence artifact to the upstream artifact it was computed from — identity + content hash, so a downstream skill (or scripts/lib/artifact_hash.py / scripts/run_replanning_checks.py) can detect a stale/mismatched chain (e.g. gaps.json computed against a different context-pack.json than the one diagnosis.json used). Never based on a timestamp alone.

artifact_id.description: The upstream artifact's own id field (e.g. context_pack_id, diagnosis_id).

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the upstream artifact's canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8) — see scripts/lib/artifact_hash.py.

path.description: Transient path the upstream artifact was read from, e.g. context/generated/<client_id>/replanning/context-pack.json. Metadata only — content_sha256 is the actual integrity check.
